positions.title: Associate Lead Consultant - Full Stack .NET
positions.description:
I drive digital transformation initiatives for Fortune 1000 clients by developing applications using a variety of leading technologies using the Microsoft Development Stack. Every day offers me a new opportunity to make my mark in this evolving market, while growing my development acumen and personal brand. I participate in emerging tech thought leadership, knowledge sharing, and have the opportunity to collaborate with Magenic's other nationally known technical leaders.​​​

As a Magenic Consultant, I use my problem solving skills every day to drive accelerated results - and each day is different. The diversity of work with our amazing clients means I'm always getting to learn something new and I stay on top of the latest industry news and trends. This helps me advance my career rapidly while building a vast and valuable professional network.
